outputs.explanation: Stacked bar chart shows median state frequencies per Pol II ChIP-seq bin, aggregating many promoters, without showing the individual promoter data points behind each median.
Single-molecule stack plot displays every individual DNA molecule as a row, so individual data points are inherently shown rather than only an average.
